notes: KEYS: SCALE LESSONS AND HELP LEVELS. The Keys page has a Help level: Full (degree colors, note names, fingers, the next note), Colors, Target (only the note to play), Tonic, or None for a bare keyboard. Whatever you pick, every key you press flashes its degree color. New Scale lessons below the keyboard: 25 graded lessons (C, G, F, A minor up to B and F♯ major, left and right hand, 3rds, 2 octaves), played with a one-bar count-in and the click. Every note is checked for the right key and how close it lands to the beat, after your device's audio delay. Each lesson has 10 levels, from quarter notes at 60 to 16ths at 72: score 85 to level up, 70 to pass. Results show notes right, timing, steadiness and whether you rush or drag, with a dot for every note. Your runs and best scores are saved, show on the Exercises Progress tab, and count toward your streak. While a lesson plays, the page folds down to just the keyboard and the lesson.
